request: Propose a repaired comparison that isolates fertilizer while keeping water equal.
sources: In a fictional seed experiment, Group A receives fertilizer and 100 mL of water daily while Group B receives no fertilizer and 50 mL daily; both use the same seed type and light exposure.
Seedling height after 14 days is the outcome; because fertilizer and water both differ, this comparison cannot isolate the effect of fertilizer.
Random assignment allocates seedlings by chance; keeping water equal while changing fertilizer removes the stated water difference.
